## What's Changed

### Versioning Note
- `v0.4.0` supersedes `v0.3.0` as the latest recommended release. This is a minor release because it adds Runtime Mechanism Mode as a new diagram expression mode with matching exporter fidelity upgrades.

### Added
- Added Runtime Mechanism Mode: a diagram mode that explains how a mechanism behaves at runtime through causal roles (trigger, participants, boundaries, carriers, transformations, state/stores, observable outputs). PR #47.
- Added `references/runtime-mechanism-mode.md` with role extraction questions, layout patterns, Draw.io annotation examples, and export micro-rules. PR #47.
- Added the Perfetto heapprofd runtime mechanism example with editable table cells, stacked worker layers, and square sample markers, plus a README showcase entry. PR #47.
- Added Sequence diagram and Data flow entries to the diagram type list so mode routing targets are all defined. PR #47.

### Fixed
- Exported `rx=0` rectangles as square `rounded=0` Draw.io cells and corrected the arcSize mapping so corner geometry survives export; exporter version bumped to 2026.06.28.1 and synced across the template and all examples. PR #47.
- Consolidated runtime mechanism guidance to single sources: routing and completion criteria live in SKILL.md, full rules live in the reference, removing duplicated rule copies. PR #47.
- Kept the Draw.io export fidelity contract out of user READMEs; READMEs stay usage-focused with a Montserrat font tip, and doc contract tests now point at SKILL.md only. PR #47.

### Documentation and Tests
- Added regression coverage for runtime mechanism docs, the example diagram, nested primitives, and Draw.io export behavior of the new mode. PR #47.
- Added the runtime mechanism example to the visual regression gate acceptance samples for release validation. PR #47.

### Verification
- Full test suite green before release tagging.
- Release validation: run the Draw.io Visual Regression Gate with `DRAWIO_VISUAL_GATE=1` on pinned renderer versions, including the runtime-mechanism sample.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/cloudy-liu/cloudy-tech-diagrams-skill/compare/v0.3.0...v0.4.0
